desc:
[NEW UPDATE: TRIALS AND WEEKLY RAID]

Play on PC, mobile, tablet and console! 💻📱🎮

Enter GloryBound, a gladiator arena game inspired by Ancient Rome. Escape prison, fight through the Colosseum and rise as a legendary Roman warrior.

CLASSES: Sword and shield, spear, bow or the Berserker's greataxe.
SURVIVAL: Squads of 4 or Solo. Revive allies through 60 waves.
HARDCORE: Wave 21 turns the arena blood red, wave 41 goes Insane.
TRIALS: Defeat Ignis, Glaucus, the Hydra of Lerna and Janus.
WEEKLY RAID: Take on the Hydra of Lerna Extreme with your squad.
BOSSES: Face the War Lion, Undead Brute and Cerberus.
CRYSTAL OF FORTUNA: Roll blessings and secret powers.
TRAINING: Build strength in the gym.
LOOT: Weapons and armor from Common to Mythic. Complete sets for bonuses.
TITLES: Earn titles and wear them over your head.
REBIRTH: Break your limits and reach the Hall of Fame.

🎁 Join Discord for codes!

Enter the arena. Fight together. Rise for Glory.
